DECLARE @REPORTDATE DATETIME = @0,@REPORTENDDATE datetime = @1, @StartTS BIGINT,@EndTS BIGINT

IF @REPORTDATE = '1/1/1901' set @REPORTDATE = CONVERT(date,getdate())
IF @REPORTENDDATE = '1/1/1901' set @REPORTENDDATE = dateadd(SECOND,-1,dateadd(DAY,1,@REPORTDATE))

DECLARE @Year INT = 2008
	,@StartOfMarch DATETIME
	,@StartOfNovember DATETIME
	,@DstStart DATETIME
	,@DstEnd DATETIME
	,@TimeZoneAdj INT

DECLARE @DaylightSavingsTimeSpans TABLE (
		DSTYear INT
	,DSTStartDTM DATETIME
	,DSTEndDTM DATETIME
	,DSTStartUNIX BIGINT
	,DSTEndUNIX BIGINT
	)

WHILE @Year < 2030
BEGIN
	SET @StartOfMarch = DATEADD(MONTH, 2, DATEADD(YEAR, @Year - 1900, 0))
	SET @StartOfNovember = DATEADD(MONTH, 10, DATEADD(YEAR, @Year - 1900, 0))
	SET @DstStart = DATEADD(HOUR, 2, DATEADD(DAY, ((15 - DATEPART(DW, @StartOfMarch)) % 7) + 7, @StartOfMarch))
	SET @DstEnd = DATEADD(HOUR, 2, DATEADD(day, ((8 - DATEPART(DW, @StartOfNovember)) % 7), @StartOfNovember))

	INSERT INTO @DaylightSavingsTimeSpans (
		DSTYear
		,DSTStartDTM
		,DSTEndDTM
		,DSTStartUNIX
		,DSTEndUNIX
		)
	SELECT @Year
		,@DstStart
		,@DstEnd
		,DATEDIFF(ss, '1/1/1970', DATEADD(HH, 5, @DstStart))
		,DATEDIFF(ss, '1/1/1970', DATEADD(HH, 4, @DstEnd))

	SET @Year = @year + 1
END

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @DaylightSavingsTimeSpans WHERE @REPORTDATE BETWEEN DSTStartDTM AND DSTEndDTM)
	SET @TimeZoneAdj = 4
ELSE
	SET @TimeZoneAdj = 5
			
SET @StartTS = DATEDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01',DATEADD(HOUR,@TimeZoneAdj, @REPORTDATE))


SET @EndTS = DATEDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01',DATEADD(HOUR,@TimeZoneAdj, @REPORTENDDATE))

SELECT @StartTS AS StartTS,@EndTS AS EndTS

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT CAF.ATTEMPT_ORDINAL AS ATTEMPT, CAF.RECORD_FIELD_23 AS RECORD_IDENTIFIER, CAF.START_TS AS CALL_TIME, CAF.RESOURCE_KEY AS AGENT_ID AS AGENT_ID_NonUnicode, CAF.CALL_RESULT_KEY AS CALL_RESULT, CAF.CONTACT_INFO AS CONTACT_INFO, CAF.RECORD_TYPE_KEY AS RECORD_TYPE  FROM GENGIM.CONTACT_ATTEMPT_FACT CAF INNER JOIN GENGIM.DATE_TIME DT_CAF_S ON (CAF.START_DATE_TIME_KEY = DT_CAF_S.DATE_TIME_KEY) AND CAF.START_TS BETWEEN 1653019200 AND 1653105600 INNER JOIN GENGIM.CALLING_LIST CL ON (CAF.CALLING_LIST_KEY = CL.CALLING_LIST_KEY) INNER JOIN GENGIM.RECORD_FIELD_GROUP_2 RFGRP_02 ON (CAF.RECORD_FIELD_GROUP_2_KEY = RFGRP_02.RECORD_FIELD_GROUP_2_KEY) INNER JOIN GENGIM.RECORD_FIELD_GROUP_1 RFGRP_01 ON (CAF.RECORD_FIELD_GROUP_1_KEY = RFGRP_01.RECORD_FIELD_GROUP_1_KEY) WHERE (RFGRP_02.RECORD_FIELD_2_STRING_3 IN ('GBDPREV','GBDPROG','GBDBLAST','GBDPPRE'))

DECLARE @tableHTML NVARCHAR(MAX) ; DECLARE @EmailRecipients NVARCHAR(MAX) ; SET @EmailRecipients = @EmailRecipients EXEC PR_PDS_VALIDATE_GENESYS_CALL_RESULT_FILES SET @tableHTML = N'

Good Morning,

Please find below daily breakdown of call lists that have been sent to Genesys dialer for member (on member list) and/or provider (on provider list) outreach and call result files received from the dialer after call attempts have been made. CALLLIST_CD column contains a three digit call list identifiers. CALLLISTDATE_IID column is a system generated key used to identify each call list generated for the day.

SENT_TO_DIALER and RECEIVED_FROM_DIALER columns show counts of members and/or providers sent to the dialer and counts of call results received from the dialer, respectively.

RECEIVED_FROM_DIALER_WITH_CALL_RESULT column shows counts of records on call result files with valid disposition codes, and RECEIVED_FROM_DIALER_WITH_NO_CALL_RESULT column shows counts of records on call result files with no valid disposition codes. Records with missing or invalid disposition codes are not processed into PDS and will be rejected.


' + N'' + N'' + CAST(( SELECT td = CALLLIST_CD,'' ,td = CALLLISTDATE_IID,'' ,td = SENT_TO_DIALER,'' ,td = RECEIVED_FROM_DIALER,'' ,td = RECEIVED_FROM_DIALER_WITH_CALL_RESULT,'' ,td = RECEIVED_FROM_DIALER_WITH_NO_CALL_RESULT,'' FROM dbo.PDS_GENESYS_RESULT_FILE_RECORD_COUNT ORDER BY CALLLIST_CD FOR XML PATH('tr'), TYPE) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + N'
CALLLIST_CDCALLLISTDATE_IIDSENT_TO_DIALERRECEIVED_FROM_DIALERRECEIVED_FROM_DIALER_WITH_CALL_RESULTRECEIVED_FROM_DIALER_WITH_NO_CALL_RESULT
' + N'

Thank you,

Data Exchange Team

' EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail @recipients= @EmailRecipients , @subject = 'Daily PDS Call Result File(s) Import Alert' , @body = @tableHTML , @body_format = 'HTML'

'SELECT CAF.attempt_ordinal AS ATTEMPT,
CAF.record_field_23 AS RECORD_IDENTIFIER,
CASE WHEN CAF.call_result_key = 5 THEN CAF.end_ts ELSE CAF.start_ts END AS CALL_TIME,
CASE WHEN R_A_CAF.employee_id = 'NONE' THEN NULL ELSE R_A_CAF.employee_id END AS AGENT_ID,
CAF.call_result_key AS CALL_RESULT,
CAF.contact_info AS CONTACT_INFO,
CAF.record_type_key AS RECORD_TYPE 
from
   DEVGENGIM.CONTACT_ATTEMPT_FACT CAF
    inner      join DEVGENGIM.DATE_TIME                      DT_CAF_S     on (CAF.start_date_time_key            = DT_CAF_S.date_time_key)
   and caf.start_ts between 0 and 0
    inner      join DEVGENGIM.CALLING_LIST                   CL           on (CAF.calling_list_key               = CL.calling_list_key)
    inner      join DEVGENGIM.RECORD_FIELD_GROUP_2           RFGRP_02     on (CAF.record_field_group_2_key       = RFGRP_02.record_field_group_2_key)
inner      join DEVGENGIM.RESOURCE_                      R_A_CAF      on (CAF.resource_key                   = R_A_CAF.resource_key)
    inner      join DEVGENGIM.RECORD_FIELD_GROUP_1           RFGRP_01     on (CAF.record_field_group_1_key       = RFGRP_01.record_field_group_1_key)
where
 (RFGRP_02.record_field_2_string_3 in ('GBDPREV','GBDPROG','GBDBLAST','GBDPPRE')) AND RFGRP_02.record_field_2_string_10 IN ('331','332','333')'
